rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for the animal.

example.english: The goat at the zoo always comes over to eat the vegetables in my hand.
example.traditional: 動物園嗰隻山羊成日走埋嚟食我手上啲菜。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 go2 zek3 saan1 joeng4 seng4 jat6 zau2 maai4 lai4 sik6 ngo5 sau2 soeng6 di1 coi3

rows.note: Use this for a man who is sexually lustful or habitually chases women.

example.english: He is always hitting on girls everywhere—he's such a goat.
example.traditional: 佢成日周街撩女仔，真係個色鬼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zau1 gaai1 liu4 neoi5 zai2 zan1 hai6 go3 sik1 gwai2
